guide.kumpel.core: Use the Kumpel Core on a block to awaken your own Kumpel: a small mining golem that follows you, collects dropped items, senses ores and levels up. Right-click it to let it sit or follow, sneak + right-click to open its backpack, feed it ores and gems for experience and repair it with copper ingots.

guide.kumpel.steiger_whistle: The Foreman's Whistle calls all your Kumpels within earshot, even the ones sitting down. Used while sneaking, it sends them all on a break. Used while sneaking on a chest (or any other container, modded ones too), it marks it as their storage: your Kumpels then bring their loot there instead of to you. Use it again to undo that. Used while sneaking on the side of any other block, the nearest Kumpel with a pickaxe digs a 1×2 tunnel into that wall. With stone in its backpack it seals water and lava and closes holes in the floor; without, it stops in front of them. What it digs goes into its backpack.
guide.kumpel.hauer: Give your Kumpel a pickaxe (right-click) and it mines exposed ores near you by itself. The pickaxe's tier and enchantments count, and it wears down. You get it back by opening the Kumpel's backpack.

The bird on its shoulder warns you about monsters nearby, makes them glow, and speaks up when you run out of air underwater. With it, your Kumpel also senses creepers from further away. Pack the Kumpel up to get the cage back.

guide.kumpel.field_forge: Give the field forge to your Kumpel (right-click). It then smelts raw ores from its backpack into ingots, burning coal from its backpack (one piece lasts for 8 ores). As long as it has coal, it keeps raw ores until they are smelted. Pack the Kumpel up to get the forge back. With nothing else to smelt, it turns spare coal into coke.

guide.kumpel.rescue_capsule: Modelled on the "Dahlbusch bomb" that brought trapped miners back to the surface in Lengede in 1963. Use it underground and hold still for three seconds, and you are pulled straight up to the surface, together with your Kumpels nearby. It only works where there is a sky above you, and it is used up.
guide.kumpel.coke: Coke is made by the field forge on a Kumpel's back when it has nothing else to smelt: it turns spare coal from the backpack into coke, like the coking plants of the Ruhr. Coke burns half as long again as coal, in a furnace as well as in the field forge.

guide.kumpel.markentafel: The Markentafel of the Markenkontrolle: at the pithead, every miner hung up a brass tag when going down, so nobody was left behind. Right-click the board to see all your Kumpels: the nearby ones as they are right now, the far-away ones where they were last seen, and how many of them are underground. Kumpels that died are listed for a while, so you know where to look for their cracked core.
guide.kumpel.music_disc_glueck_auf: The Kumpelkapelle's own march. Your Kumpels dance and sing along to it, and their good mood gives you Haste while you are near them. Found in abandoned mineshafts, or made from coal and a note block.

item.kumpel.kumpelfibel.tooltip: A little handbook about your Kumpel
guide.kumpel.kumpelfibel: A little handbook about everything your Kumpel can do. You get one with your very first Kumpel; more can be made from a book and a copper ingot.
fibel.kumpel.page.0:
§lKumpelfibel§r

Everything about your Kumpel, the little mining golem.


§oGlück auf!§r
fibel.kumpel.page.1:
§lAwakening§r

Craft a Kumpel Core and use it on the ground. Your Kumpel awakens, gets a name from the Pott and follows you from then on.

Right-click: sit or follow.
fibel.kumpel.page.2:
§lBackpack & Care§r

Sneak + right-click opens its Kiepe. Copper ingots repair it. Ores, metals and gems feed it XP, and every level brings more health, a bigger Kiepe and a new look.
fibel.kumpel.page.3:
§lOre Sensing§r

The Kumpel points at the most valuable ore nearby and tells you where it is. A compass turns this on or off. From level 4, the ore glows through the rock.
fibel.kumpel.page.4:
§lHauer§r

Give it a pickaxe and it mines exposed ores near you. Fortune and Silk Touch count. Torches in its Kiepe light up dark spots, food in it feeds you when you're hungry.
fibel.kumpel.page.5:
§lSteigerpfeife§r

Use: all Kumpels come.
Sneak: they take a break.
Sneak on a chest: their storage.
Sneak on a wall: the nearest Hauer digs a tunnel.
fibel.kumpel.page.6:
§lVortrieb§r

The Kumpel digs a 1×2 tunnel and lights it. Water and lava are sealed with stone from its Kiepe, holes in the floor closed. Without stone, it stops and tells you why.
fibel.kumpel.page.7:
§lFeldschmiede§r

Strap a field forge to its back: it smelts raw ores from its Kiepe with coal. With nothing to smelt, it turns spare coal into coke, which burns longer.
fibel.kumpel.page.8:
§lDanger§r

Creepers near you glow. A canary in a cage on its shoulder warns about monsters and air. The Grubenwehr: the Kumpel fights monsters that attack you.
fibel.kumpel.page.9:
§lLight§r

Underground, its helmet lamp lights the way. Your own Grubenhelm lets you see in the dark.
fibel.kumpel.page.10:
§lShafts§r

Förderkorb: right-click rides up to the next cage, sneak rides down. Your Kumpels ride along.

Rescue capsule: hold still for three seconds to be pulled up.
fibel.kumpel.page.11:
§lAusfahrt§r

Lost underground? Sneak + right-click your Kumpel with a compass, and it leads you out the way you came.
fibel.kumpel.page.12:
§lRecords§r

Hand it a book: it writes its shift report with its best ore finds. A Markentafel shows all your Kumpels, even far away ones.
fibel.kumpel.page.13:
§lFeierabend§r

When you sleep, your Kumpels sit down and rest. They dance to jukeboxes, and to their own record, Glück auf, they sing along.
fibel.kumpel.page.14:
§lBarbaratag§r

On 4 December, Saint Barbara's Day, Kumpels wear a blossoming branch and feeding them gives double XP.


§oGlück auf, Kumpel!§r
